install.title: Set it up
install.intro: A few steps. A whole new look.
install.manual: iOS handles the final setup. Tap each step when you've completed it; we'll remember your progress.
install.wallpaper.1: Open Settings → Wallpaper → Add New Wallpaper. Choose Photos and select the image you saved.
install.wallpaper.2: For a Live Photo, enable motion if iOS offers it. For an eligible image, try Spatial Scene. Adjust the crop and clock in the system editor.
install.wallpaper.3: Tap Add, then choose Set as Wallpaper Pair or customize your Home Screen. Wake your phone to check the result.
install.icons.1: Export the icon pack and save the folder to Files. Choose the image for the app you want to customize.
install.icons.2: In Shortcuts, create an Open App action and choose the app. Open its menu and select Add to Home Screen.
install.icons.3: Tap the icon, choose your saved image and give it a name. Tap Add. Repeat for your other apps; original app icons are unchanged.
install.widgets.1: Choose your widget background in ScreenMotion. On the Home Screen, touch and hold an empty area.
install.widgets.2: Tap Edit → Add Widget, find ScreenMotion, choose a size and tap Add Widget. On older iOS versions, use the + button.
install.widgets.3: Touch and hold the widget → Edit Widget to choose Photo, Clock & Date, Calendar or Collection. Lock Screen widgets are added in the system Lock Screen editor.

spatial.title: Tilt your Lock Screen
spatial.subtitle: On iOS 26, a still wallpaper can become a Spatial Scene that shifts as you tilt your iPhone.
spatial.requires: Spatial Scene needs iOS 26 or later.
spatial.saveStill: Save a still for Spatial Scene
spatial.step.1: Save a still image of this scene to Photos.
spatial.step.2: Open Settings › Wallpaper › Add New Wallpaper, choose Photos and pick the image.
spatial.step.3: Tap the Spatial Scene button in the corner. iOS adds depth to the image.
spatial.step.4: Tap Add, then tilt your iPhone on the Lock Screen to see it shift.
spatial.note: iOS decides which images support Spatial Scene. Reduce Motion and Low Power Mode turn the effect off.

nightstand.auto.title: Open on charge
nightstand.auto.detail: Make Nightstand your charging screen. A Shortcuts automation can open it every time you plug in.
nightstand.auto.step1: Open Shortcuts, tap Automation, then tap +.
nightstand.auto.step2: Choose Charger, select Is Connected and Run Immediately.
nightstand.auto.step3: Add the Open URLs action and paste the link below.
nightstand.auto.step4: Plug in your iPhone. Nightstand opens with your last scene.
